content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About USD.AI (CHIP)
content.description: USD.AI is a decentralized lending protocol that provides dollar-denominated liquidity for the artificial intelligence infrastructure ecosystem by financing compute hardware such as GPUs.

content.title: What is Plume about?
content.description: Plume is the first RWAfi L1 network focused on crypto natives, building infrastructure to connect the real world and crypto markets. It challenges the traditional view of RWAs by introducing new, crypto-first RWA use cases, including RWA derivatives, speculation, borrowing, lending, yield farming, and more, rather than simply replicating traditional finance on the blockchain.

content.title: About Sui (SUI)
content.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain designed for global adoption by providing a high-speed and secure environment for digital asset ownership.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About Velvet (VELVET)
content.description: Velvet is an AI-powered onchain trading and portfolio management terminal designed to integrate spot, perpetuals, and yield strategies into a single vertically integrated system.

content.title: About Bitcoin (BTC)
content.description: Bitcoin is the world's first decentralized cryptocurrency that enables peer-to-peer electronic cash transactions without intermediaries like banks or governments.

content.title: About Chainlink (LINK)
content.description: Chainlink is the industry-standard decentralized oracle network that connects smart contracts with real-world data and off-chain systems.

content.title: What Is ether.fi?
content.description:
ether.fi is a modern crypto neobank that replaces the traditional consumer bank. Users can save, grow, and spend their crypto through one connected experience. Common use cases include buying tokens, earning on crypto through vaults, sending money globally through fiat on and off ramps, and purchasing every day goods through a credit card.

Behind that experience is crypto-native, non-custodial infrastructure that keeps users in control of their assets. Rather than separating investments from everyday finances, ether.fi makes it possible to put assets to work, access liquidity against them, and use them in daily life from the same platform.

Stake provides access to Ethereum staking while keeping positions liquid and usable. Liquid automates onchain strategies designed to generate variable yield across eligible assets. Cash supports card spending and payments. Trading, transfers, and collateralized borrowing bring additional flexibility, giving users more ways to manage and use their wealth without first selling their holdings.

With more than $3 billion in assets across the platform, ether.fi combines the technical foundation of a leading DeFi protocol with the simplicity and utility of a modern fintech platform. The result is a financial home for modern wealth: one place to grow it, move it, borrow against it, and use it—while remaining in control.

content.title: What is UNI?
content.description: UNI is the governance token for Uniswap. UNI was introduced on 16th September 2020 through a retrospective airdrop to users who have interacted with the protocol either by swapping tokens or by providing liquidity.

content.title: What is pump.fun?
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin generator/launchpad that simplifies the process of creating tokens, allowing users to launch their own memecoins without needing technical expertise.
